name: qkd_kvs_ctl_c32d-c32d-COMMIT
purpose: KV-CTL12 10-21 STRUCTURAL successor of c32b after gate222038 FAIL (both c32a/b: trial GRT GRT-0183 boxed net during repair of 2224 setup endpoints; TT WNS -420/-676; classes: boot_image_epoch -> o_hroot in->reg 1037 ps (-687/-817), i_hroot_EN -> bobs f1 in->reg -262, o_attn/lprg -> lp/kg out -281/-397, boot o_lw -> o_hroot reg->reg 867 ps). Fixes: (1) pin registers ON for every data input and every output except o_hroot_* (already RTL member flops): inputs land at the face, outputs launch from a face flop (+1 edge each, die schedule absorbs); (2) RTL: the boot /6 and %6 are taken from the RAW address in parallel with the MU seal accept (qkd_kv_ctl_c32_div6r + word-326 constants), removing ~350 ps from the boot accept -> strobe stage, 0 added edges, same function. c32d = FALLBACK: same + outline 345.6 x 561.6 (13 x 43.2; W/E 2652 pins over ~449 um usable = 5.9/um vs 7.0/um on 475.2, the GRT-0183 boxed-net face density); macros shifted +43.2 um to stay centred; die slot grows 86.4 um in Y.
